entry.title: How We Got DDEV, Laravel, and a Go API Talking: The Sidecar Approach
entry.summary: Ahnii! Our stack splits responsibilities: Laravel (DDEV) handles auth and the UI; a Go service serves the API. We needed the Laravel app inside DDEV to call the Go API reliably. Here’s how we did it. Laravel runs in a DDEV web container. Go was either on the host or in its own Docker Compose. From inside the web container, localhost:8090 points at the container itself, not the host. Using host.docker.internal:8090 led to timeouts (routing/WSL2) or required the Go app to listen on 0.0.0.0. When we did get a response, we often saw 401 Unauthorized: the shared secret for signed requests didn’t match between Laravel and Go.
